# mistershell_automation_playbook (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell automation playbook.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_automation_playbook" "example" {
  name        = "recorded-session-workflow"
  description = "A disabled workflow ready for actions."
  enabled     = false
  graph = {
    trigger = { event_name = "resource.session.recorded" }
    nodes   = []
    edges   = []
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Graph. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `last_run_at` (String) Last run at.
- `last_run_status` (String) Last run status.
- `run_count` (Number) Run count.
- `trigger_event_name` (String) Trigger event name.
- `trigger_filters` (Dynamic) Trigger filters. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Webhook secrets and import

The `graph` attribute is sensitive. Terraform state still contains any secret supplied in configuration; protect state storage accordingly.

The API masks webhook bearer tokens, basic authentication passwords and custom header values. Import records these unavailable secrets as `null`. Leave an imported secret `null` or omit its key to preserve the stored credential while editing other graph fields. Preservation requires the same node `id`, `action_id = "webhook"` and authentication `type`; new nodes and authentication types require an explicit secret. Never configure the API's `****` mask as a credential.

Supply a real value to rotate a credential. Removing or nulling a previously configured, known secret is rejected. To disable webhook authentication explicitly, set its `auth` object to `{ type = "none" }`. Removing the webhook node also removes its authentication configuration.

## Import

```shell
terraform import mistershell_automation_playbook.example 123
```
